title: Vladdin Classic Replacement Pods 0.8ohm - 3 Pods
description: The Vladdin Classic Replacement Pods are an essential accessory for your Vladdin Classic device. These 0.8ohm pods come in a pack of three and are designed to keep your vaping experience fresh and flavourful. Each pod boasts a 2ml e-liquid capacity, perfect for regular use and ensuring you always have a backup ready. With their easy-to-use design, these replacement pods simplify the vaping process. They are ideal for those who prefer hassle-free maintenance without compromising on quality. The 0.8ohm coil within each pod is optimized for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, providing a smooth draw and excellent flavour from your favourite e-liquids, especially effective with 50/50 blends and Nic Salts. Refilling these pods is straightforward, thanks to their 2ml capacity and efficient design. The pods ensure that you experience a clean and mess-free refill process every time. Whether you're at home or on the go, these Vladdin Classic Replacement Pods are a reliable choice, ensuring that your Vladdin Classic Pod Kit continues to deliver the high-quality vaping experience you expect. We Recommend paring these pods with Nic Salt or High PG E-Liquids Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
